definitions.explanation: A group of people sharing common ancestry, physical characteristics, or cultural heritage. Also used in fantasy and gaming contexts for fictional races or species.

examples.japanese: さまざまな{種族|しゅぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{共存|きょうぞん}→共存：11675_kyouzon⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種族|しゅぞく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: In this game, you can choose a character from five races.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧{種族|しゅぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{互|たが}い→互い：03402_tagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧し⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important for people of different ethnic groups to respect each other's cultures.

notes:
USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {種族|しゅぞく} is commonly used in fantasy literature, games, and anime for fictional races (elves, dwarves, etc.). In academic or anthropological contexts, ⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧ is generally preferred for real-world ethnic groups, though {種族|しゅぞく} still appears.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧: ethnic group, nation (more commonly used for real-world groups)
- ⟦{人種|じんしゅ}→人種：03354_jinshu⟧: race (biological/physical classification)
- ⟦{部族|ぶぞく}→部族：14435_buzoku⟧: tribe (a more specific social unit)
